name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=ui, descriptor 'item_command_menu_template' correctly reflects a const option-list table). No Ghidra address residue; no domain-ID suffix needed. Name and 'template' descriptor accurately reflect the const int[4] menu-option array data type.
purpose: Battle item-command submenu option list: 4 text-token-ids (one per menu label) copied into a local menu_options buffer to drive the Use/Give/Sort-Equip/Drop menu.
logic_summary: const int32[4] = {8,9,10,11}. Sole reader fd2_item_command_menu_dispatch (0x1BBDC) copies all four ints into a local menu_options[16] buffer via a count-4 REP MOVSD (int*/stride-4 loop), then opens a settings dialog (fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide). The user-selected cursor index 0..3 dispatches: 0=Use, 1=Give, 2=Sort/Equip, 3=Drop. Paired with the per-option enable/disable flags data_fd2_ui_item_command_menu_state_template @ 0x53F32 (e.g. Give greyed out when no adjacent ally tile in range). The source array is never written game-side; only the local copy is consumed/mutated.
element_semantics: Each int32 element is a text-token-id (UI string token) for a menu-entry label, displayed in cursor order: [0]=8=Use, [1]=9=Give, [2]=10=Sort/Equip, [3]=11=Drop. Tokens 8..11 are the contiguous item-action label tokens.
